question: If 5x - (1)/(4x) = 6, x > 0, then find the value of 25x² -(1)/(16x²⁾.
solution:
**Given:**

5x - 1/4x= 6, x > 0,

**Formula used:**

( a - b )² = a² + b² - 2ab 

( a + b )² = a² + b² + 2ab 

( a² - b² ) = ( a - b ) ( a + b )

**Calculation:**

5x - 1/4x = 6 

Squaring both sides 

⇒ ( 5x - 1/4x )² = 6² 

⇒ 25x²+ 1/16x² - 2 × 5x
